I need to consider what the cricket score of 111 is called.

The other agents have all answered "Nelson" with very high confidence (0.95-0.96). This is indeed correct - in cricket, the score of 111 (or multiples like 222, 333) is traditionally called "Nelson," named after Admiral Lord Nelson who supposedly had "one eye, one arm, one leg" (though this is actually historically inaccurate as Nelson had both legs). It's considered by some to be an unlucky score.
